# TASK-158 — Tasks appear when the specification is correct

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Automatic task breakdown and agent access (2026-10-02)

## Intent

Baseline approval calls the same function and merges the result into the board without deleting anything. A board that changed at the same moment (revision conflict) is retried once; if it still conflicts the approval stands and the Board's refresh action is the way to catch up.

## What it delivers

Implemented in `api/board.ts` and `review.ts`; the Board shows "Waits for" and the plan's gaps. Verified against PostgreSQL once Docker was back: `tests/api.test.ts` (approval creates the tasks and audits it), `tests/board.test.ts` (epics, dependencies and foundations from the real catalog, refresh keeps progress, approval never fails), plus the Board component test, and the browser journey `e2e/workspace.spec.ts` (baseline approval, the tasks already on the board, "Refresh from baseline", move by keyboard, `.plan` export; axe).

## History

- 2026-10-02 - CHG-035 Tasks appear when the specification is correct, and agents can read and write the project (TASK-157, TASK-158, TASK-159)
